observed: 18.0 to 18.8 s side view of a residential street under brown floodwater: a white car with roof sensor stands in the water in front of houses and a large live oak, its reflection below. The car shifts slightly right and stops, and the water line climbs so the wheels are mostly under water by 18.8 s. A dark curved shape at the right edge of the water disappears. No hazard lamp visible at this size. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. The car sits just above the caption box.
